beats.care: Doing a vehicle or desk pooja? Buy only what you need. Shoppers hope prices ease once the festival rush ends.
beats.what: At KR Market, jasmine sold for roughly ₹1,400–2,000 a kg and sevanthige for ₹250–400, three outlets reported.
beats.why: Traders blame lower crop yields and rain damage, while Ayudha Pooja and Dasara demand peaked at the same time.

cards.body: Reported rates differ by outlet and time of day, but all three put jasmine well above ₹1,000 a kg.
cards.caption: a kg of jasmine at KR Market

cards.body: Sevanthige hit up to ₹400 a kg, Asianet Newsable reported, against a usual high of ₹80. A pair of banana stems for vehicle pooja went up to ₹120.
cards.title: What else got pricey

opts: Weather-hit crops met peak festival demand
Flowers were banned from other states
cards.q: Why did flower prices jump this festival?
cards.why: Traders blamed poor yields and rain damage, at the very moment everyone wanted flowers.

hook: Why did *jasmine cost so much* at KR Market this Dasara?

learn.t: Traders say festive prices usually rise 5–10%, but some items jumped as much as 50% this year.
